hooks.name: Session briefing
hooks.description: Start every session knowing what changed and what's uncommitted.

hooks.name: No secrets in a public repo
hooks.description: Block writes containing AWS keys, private keys, GitHub/Slack tokens, Kiro Crew webhook tokens or a Kiro API key.

hooks.name: Regenerate the scenarios doc
hooks.description: docs/advanced-scenarios.md is generated; keep it in sync whenever scenarios.json is saved.

hooks.name: Property tests on builder changes
hooks.description: Any change to the builder or its tests reruns the Hypothesis properties.

hooks.name: Use cases must match their lab
hooks.description: When the catalog changes, have the agent check each new or edited use case against the lab it links to.

action.prompt: site/data/catalog.json was saved. For every use case or learning-path entry that changed (git diff), open the lab it links to and confirm the lab actually teaches what the use case claims. Report mismatches; do not invent capabilities.

hooks.name: Done means green
hooks.description: Before the agent stops: build the site, check the generated scenarios doc, and run the tests.

action.command: python3 scripts/build_site.py && python3 scripts/gen_scenarios_md.py --check && python -m pytest tests -q -p no:cacheprovider
